subject: single healthy adult, 1.06 mm isotropic, 3T single-orientation GRE
reference_note: The STI chi_33 susceptibility map (computed from 12 head orientations) is the held-out ground-truth reference for this subject. It is NOT provided here.
field_units: ppm (local tissue field already normalized by gamma*TE*B0; background field removed)

inversion.method: closed-form L2 (Tikhonov) with a gradient (finite-difference) regularizer
inversion.dipole_kernel: D(k) = 1/3 - k_z^2 / |k|^2 with B0 along axis index 2; D(0) := 1/3
inversion.apply_mask: multiply the image-space susceptibility by the brain mask

roi_labels_note: Labels 1-6 are deep-gray nuclei; labels 7-11 are white-matter regions (the challenge evaluation mask defines WM as labels > 6). The deep-gray names are assigned from anatomical location and the iron/susceptibility ordering; grading is by label index so the identity of the two required nuclei (globus pallidus = 3, putamen = 2) is fixed by label.
output_units: ppb (report susceptibility in parts-per-billion; 1 ppm = 1000 ppb)
